description: This file is a shell script used for testing the pack-objects multi-pack reuse feature in Git. It contains test setup, configuration, and various test cases verifying pack reuse behavior, delta handling, and multi-pack index features.

methods.name: test_pack_reused
methods.description: Wraps the test_trace2_data function to verify pack reuse in trace output.

methods.name: test_packs_reused
methods.description: Wraps the test_trace2_data function to verify multiple packs reuse.

methods.name: pack_position
methods.description: Finds the position of an object within a pack index.

methods.name: test_pack_objects_reused_all
methods.description: Tests that all objects are reused from specified packs, verifies delta reuse.

methods.name: test_pack_objects_reused
methods.description: Tests that objects are reused with delta considerations, using different configurations.
